_source.title: 获取当前工程的详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的原理图、PCB、面板所关联的工程的详细属性
_source.returns: 工程属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get detailed properties of Current project
remarks.text.0: It will get the detailed properties of the project associated with the currently open schematic, PCB, or panel that has the last input focus
returns: Project property; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
